segments.text: Here is your levothyroxine, fifty micrograms.
Take it once a day in the morning, on an empty stomach, um, before breakfast.
Avoid taking it at the same time as iron or calcium tablets.
If you forget to take it, take it when you remember that day.
Keep the tablets in the box, away from heat and light.
